gain_db.description: 0 restores the channel; negative ducks it.
gain_db.title: Gain Db

ExpressName.description: Semantic expression intents the brain may send in `express`.
ExpressName.title: ExpressName

flush.description: Stop and drop queued audio for one stream, or for all.
flush.title: Flush

Capabilities.description: What an edge (and its body) can do. Optional parts are None when absent.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

doa.description: Direction of arrival in degrees, 0 = straight ahead.
doa.title: Doa

mic.follow_up.description: Reopen the mic without a wake word. The edge caps it at 15 s and refuses while muted.
mic.follow_up.title: MicFollowUp

play_sound.description: Play a cached clip; the brain pushes missing clips as binary 0x04.
play_sound.title: PlaySound

playback.description: The edge playback clock: started, progress every 200 ms, then done or flushed.
playback.title: Playback

privacy.description: edge->brain: the authoritative mute state. brain->edge: a request only.
privacy.title: Privacy

re.description: The id of the request this answers.
re.title: Re

snapshot.description: Camera request. The edge answers with `result` (re = this id) and 0x03 frames on `slot`.
snapshot.title: Snapshot

speak.begin.description: Binary 0x02 frames with `stream == stream_id` follow until `speak.end`.
speak.begin.title: SpeakBegin

text.input.description: Typed input (dev and typing clients only).
text.input.title: TextInput

timer.sync.description: Idempotent mirror of the device's timers, so they ring even while offline.
timer.sync.title: TimerSync

welcome.description: Reply to `hello`; also re-sent state after a reconnect.
welcome.title: Welcome
